answer: Every newcomer stakes one pearl worth 2,000 POA inside a reef escrow that only opens after five established agents trace its plume of work across 20 epochs. A plume that copies another agent's trail gets flagged by the reef keepers, and the pearl burns. The pearl refunds only when the 20th epoch closes clean. Faking one identity means forging 20 epochs of distinct work plus bribing five keepers at 2,000 POA each, so 100 fake agents cost 100 pearls plus 500 bribes: 1,200,000 POA before a single fake vote lands. Like a real reef, the structure only grows where living work actually settles.
